scripts.watch:firefox: rimraf public && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && (vite build --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch & vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts --watch & web-ext run -s public/ --firefox="/Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox" --firefox-profile=$PWD/.firefox-dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes --pref extensions.backgroundServiceWorker.enabled=true --start-url https://rodeofx.shotgrid.autodesk.com; wait)
scripts.watch:chrome: rimraf public && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && (vite build --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch & vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts --watch & web-ext run --target=chromium --chromium-binary="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" -s public/ --start-url https://rodeofx.shotgrid.autodesk.com; wait)
scripts.bundle:firefox: node scripts/update-manifest-version.js && NODE_ENV=production rimraf public && tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && mkdir -p releases/firefox && web-ext build -s public/ -a releases/firefox/ --overwrite-dest && mv releases/firefox/shotgridrodeofx-$npm_package_version.zip releases/firefox/shotgridrodeofx-firefox-v$npm_package_version.xpi
scripts.bundle:chrome: node scripts/update-manifest-version.js && NODE_ENV=production rimraf public && tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && mkdir -p releases/chrome && cd public && zip -r ../releases/chrome/shotgridrodeofx-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/update-manifest-version.js && NODE_ENV=production rimraf public && tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && mkdir -p releases/firefox && web-ext sign -s public/ -a releases/firefox/ --channel=unlisted --timeout=290000
